message.content:
I don’t have a tool that can pull up a list of security guards, but I can give you some practical ways to find the most popular (and reputable) security guard services in New York:

| Step | What to Do | Why It Helps |
|------|------------|--------------|
| 1 | **Search online directories** – Sites like Yelp, Google Maps, and Angi (formerly Angie’s List) let you filter by “Security Guard” and “New York.” | You’ll see ratings, reviews, and photos from real customers. |
| 2 | **Check local security companies’ websites** – Many firms list their staff, certifications, and client testimonials. Look for firms that are licensed by the New York State Department of State and have a good standing with the NYS Office of the Attorney General. | Licensing and compliance are key indicators of professionalism. |
| 3 | **Ask for referrals** – If you know businesses or property managers in NYC, ask them which guard companies they trust. | Word‑of‑mouth recommendations often point to reliable, well‑trained personnel. |
| 4 | **Verify credentials** – In New York, security guards must be licensed by the NYS Department of State. Ask the company for proof of each guard’s license, background check, and training certificates. | Ensures the guard is legally authorized and has undergone proper vetting. |
| 5 | **Read reviews on independent sites** – Sites like Trustpilot, BBB (Better Business Bureau), and local forums (e.g., NYC subreddits) can reveal patterns of complaints or praise. | Multiple sources help confirm consistency in quality. |
| 6 | **Interview candidates** – If you’re hiring an individual guard, ask about their experience, training (e.g., first aid, firearms if applicable), and references. | Direct conversation can uncover soft skills that matter for on‑site presence. |
| 7 | **Check insurance coverage** – A reputable guard company should carry liability insurance and workers’ compensation. | Protects you from potential legal or financial issues. |

### Quick Resources

| Resource | Link |
|----------|------|
| NYS Department of State – Security Guard Licensing | https://dos.ny.gov/security-guard-licensing |
| Better Business Bureau – New York | https://www.bbb.org/us/ny |
| Yelp – Security Guard NYC | https://www.yelp.com/search?find_desc=Security+Guard&find_loc=New+York%2C+NY |
| Google Maps – Security Guard NYC | https://www.google.com/maps/search/security+guard+nyc/ |

If you have a specific type of guard in mind (e.g., armed guard, event security, residential guard), let me know and I can narrow down the suggestions further.
